sources.title: Granite 4.1 | IBM Granite
sources.snippet: Granite 4.1 Dense language model family in 3B, 8B, and 30B sizes with instruction-tuned variants, delivering improved tool calling, instruction following, coding, and mathematical reasoning.

sources.title: GitHub - ibm-granite/granite-4.2-language-models · GitHub
sources.snippet: The Granite 4.2 familiy features dense decoder-only architectures in three sizes — 3B, 8B, and 30B, with quantized variants per model size. The Granite 4.2 dense models are post-trained on top of Granite 4.1 base models. Please refer to the Granite 4.1 blog for details on the pre-training phase.
